dismissal.catalog-id-invalid: “{{value}}” is not a catalog id, which is a number such as 603.

list.tab-switched-off: This tab is switched off in your profile.
list.tab-missing: Choose a tab: Movies, Series, Cartoons or Documentaries.
list.tab-unknown: “{{value}}” is not a recommendation tab. Use Movies, Series, Cartoons or Documentaries.
list.reason-unknown: “{{value}}” is not a recommendation reason. Use Collection, Director, Creator, Recommended, MissingSeasons, TopRated or NewAtSource.
list.availability-invalid: “{{value}}” is not an availability filter. Use true or false.
list.genre-invalid: “{{value}}” is not a genre id, which is a number such as 18.
list.decade-invalid: “{{value}}” is not a decade. Use its first year, such as 1990.
list.sort-unknown: “{{value}}” is not a sort. Use Score, Rating, Votes, Newest, Oldest, Title or Releases.
list.kind-unknown: “{{value}}” is not a kind of work. Use Movie or Series.

overview.language-invalid: “{{value}}” is not a language code, which is two letters with a region when wanted, such as en or uk-UA.
overview.fetch-failed: The metadata catalog couldn't send this description.

settings.daily-search-limit-invalid: The daily search limit is a whole number from 0 to 500.
settings.unreadable-body: Send the settings as JSON: movies, series, cartoons and documentaries true or false, and dailySearchLimit a whole number from 0 to 500.
settings.movies-missing: Say whether the Movies tab is on.
settings.series-missing: Say whether the Series tab is on.
settings.cartoons-missing: Say whether the Cartoons tab is on.
settings.documentaries-missing: Say whether the Documentaries tab is on.

poster.fetch-failed: The metadata catalog couldn't send this poster.

run.restarted: The app restarted before these recommendations were computed. The previous ones are kept.
run.queue-full: Too many recommendation runs are waiting. Try again in a minute.
run.app-error: The recommendations stopped computing because of an error in the app. Its log says more.
run.catalog-removed: The metadata catalog was removed while these recommendations were computed. The previous ones are kept.

list.listed_one: {{count, number}} recommendation on the {{tab}} tab in all; page {{page, number}} lists {{listed, number}}.
list.listed_other: {{count, number}} recommendations on the {{tab}} tab in all; page {{page, number}} lists {{listed, number}}.

dismiss.movie-marked: Movie {{catalogId}} is marked Not interested and leaves your recommendations; the web app can undo it.
dismiss.series-marked: Series {{catalogId}} is marked Not interested and leaves your recommendations; the web app can undo it.
